content.title: Goodwill to close every store for 24 hours on Easter Sunday – but there are 5 alternatives
content.text: THRIFT giant Goodwill is planning a 24-hour blackout across its fleet of 3,400 outlets this weekend for Easter Sunday. Although the secondhand chain will close its doors nationwide in the coming days, shoppers in search of a bargain can hit up five other alternatives. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! Goodwill is the most popular thrift store in the countryCredit: Alamy Although Goodwill is planning to close nationwide for Easter Sunday, shoppers can turn to five other alternativesCredit: Getty The majority of Goodwill locations will temporarily close down on April 5 in honor of Easter Sunday, as it is considered a major holiday for many regional branches. A number of Goodwill organizations have confirmed via social media or online that they will shutter for the day, including those in New Jersey and Houston. Some branches may opt to keep the lights on this Sunday for shoppers. For example, Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest announced on its website that all its thrift stores and donation centers will be open and operating at their regular hours for Easter. Shoppers are encouraged to double check with their specific local Goodwill branch for its hours this Sunday, or to complete their shopping or donations on Saturday ahead of the holiday. In addition to Goodwill, most popular secondhand shops like Salvation Army and the St. Vincent de Paul thrift stores will be closed for the day. Other large retailers with home and clothing departments will also shut down for 24 hours this weekend, including Target, TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Costco, and Kohl’s. What stores are closed on Easter Sunday? Most read in Money For example, shoppers can visit Big Lots this weekend to browse the aisles for home goods, furniture, and discount groceries. Those in search of quick household items, craft supplies, or seasonal decorations can turn to Dollar General, as the discount chain is generally open for business on Easter Sunday. IKEA locations typically stay open for the holiday as well, making it a great option for shoppers who were planning to look for furniture or home accessories. Old Navy and Walmart are also ideal Goodwill alternatives this Sunday, as they are generally open on Easter, unlike many other big-box retailers. Story idea?
